I'll need to look up what's on your schedule today to work around that. You're not currently running a program. What I can do: if you want to build a session today that skips lunges and step-ups because of the hip, I'll build it around whatever you've got — tell me what you're aiming for (which muscle groups, strength or conditioning, how much time you've got) and I'll put together something that works.

The hip thing though — if it's still bothering you after a day or two, worth getting that checked by a physio so we know what to avoid going forward.
